name: BAW 817 鸟击 左风挡裂

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 817, you are at stand 215, contact Wuhan Ground and request a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Speedbird 817，停在 215 机位，联系武汉地面，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW817, stand 215, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW817，215 机位，请求拖车。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 817, what type of aircraft is it?
B: Tell the controller its Airbus 330.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 817，机型是什么？
B：告诉管制员是 Airbus 330。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 817, the tug is on the way.
B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, request facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好推出和开车，请求机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW817, request push back and start up, facing east.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW817，请求推出开车，机头朝东。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 04, you notice the wind sock shows strong wind, contact Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，发现风向袋显示风较强，联系武汉塔台核实风况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW817, holding point runway 04, the wind sock shows strong wind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW817，跑道 04 等待点，风向袋显示风较强，请求风况检查。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 817, wind 200, 8 meters per second.
B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Wuhan Tower to change to runway 22 and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 817，风 200，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系武汉塔台请求改用跑道 22，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: The tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to runway 22, BAW817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 22，BAW817。

cards.audioText: B: After departure, you encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked, this is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：离场后你遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹，发出紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure/Approach, BAW817, we encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场/进近，BAW817，遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 817, roger PAN, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you want to dump fuel and return to land.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 817，收到 PAN，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员你想放油并返场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Request dump fuel and return to land, BAW817.

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 817, turn right, heading 240 to intercept Lima Kilo Oscar 030 radial inbound, climb to 3300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 817，右转航向 240，切入 Lima Kilo Oscar 030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, heading 240 to intercept LKO 030 radio inbound, climb to 3300 meters, BAW817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 LKO 030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米，BAW817。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 817, after passing Lima Kilo Oscar, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over Lima Kilo Oscar.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 817，过 Lima Kilo Oscar 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 Lima Kilo Oscar 报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO, BAW817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告，BAW817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over Lima Kilo Oscar, report it to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 Lima Kilo Oscar，向武汉进近报告。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 817, how long do you need to dump fuel?
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 817，你需要多长时间放油？
B：告诉管制员大约需要 25 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW817, we need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW817，我们大约需要 25 分钟。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed fuel dumping, report it to the controller and request radar vectors for runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成放油，向管制员报告并请求雷达引导至跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW817, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW817，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 817, turn right, direct to Delta Alpha, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 817，右转直飞 Delta Alpha，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach runway 22, BAW817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22，BAW817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS runway 22, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW817, established ILS runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW817，已建立跑道 22 ILS。

cards.audioText: B: During landing, you encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：着陆过程中，你在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW817, we encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW817，我们在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you find the APU is inoperative, report this situation to Wuhan Ground and request ground power unit ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，你发现 APU 失效，向武汉地面报告并请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW817, our APU is inoperative, request ground power unit ready at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW817，APU 失效，请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。
